name: J.D. Walker
tagline: Top rated Immigration attorney in Stafford, Texas
about: J.D. Walker is a nationally recognized immigration attorney with extensive experience representing clients from around the world. His practice focuses on adjustment of status, family-based immigration, asylum, and removal defense, as well as business immigration and appellate matters. He is known for delivering strategic, results-driven representation tailored to each client’s unique circumstances.

As founder and Lead Immigration Attorney at J.D. Walker Immigration Attorneys, Mr. Walker has built a team of skilled and diverse professionals committed to providing high-quality, client-centered legal services. The firm emphasizes efficiency, personalized attention, and a compassionate approach to guiding individuals and families through complex immigration processes.

Mr. Walker also founded and chairs the Birmingham Bar Association’s Immigration Committee, where he contributes to advancing the practice of immigration law, sharing industry insights, and serving as a bridge between the legal community and the public.

Recognized among the top immigration attorneys in the United States, Mr. Walker has received numerous honors, including selection to Best Attorneys of America, Lawyers of Distinction, The National Advocates, and National Black Lawyers Top 40 Under 40. He has also been named among the Best Attorneys in America and is widely regarded for his commitment to excellence and preparation in every case he handles. Mr. Walker is a member of the Forbes Business Council, a professional community of business leaders and executives. Through his involvement with the Council, he contributes his professional perspective on leadership, business, and immigration-related issues.
